text:
maria (AE): Quick sync — Finora POC kickoff tomorrow AM. Primary asks: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC group mapping, and domain proofing. Also pricing question re: committed throughput. Who can join the call?

sam (SE): I can join. Do we know which IdP they're using?

alex (sales-eng): They're on Okta (SAML 2.0). SCIM endpoint is required for provisioning; they asked for bulk provisioning and group sync. Also legal asked about domain ownership verification flow.

jordan (security): I've got the security questionnaire they sent. Key items to address: cert rotation for SAML, SCIM token rotation policy, RBAC audit logs (retention + tamper evidence), data residency, and proof of SOC2. I'll pull our standard pack.

emily (solutions): For pricing — they want 50 committed QPS for generation. Hosted metered vs Dedicated reserved will change numbers a lot. Quick guesstimate: hosted monthly metered ~ $Xk/mo at that volume; dedicated annual commit will be ~ $Yk/mo. I'll draft numbers but need final traffic profile.

maria (AE): Action items: 1) request SAML metadata and attribute mapping from Finora, 2) request SCIM base URL + token + sample payload, 3) confirm domain control method, 4) capture billing contact for quote. @alex can you draft the initial quote? @sam can you prepare the POC checklist?

alex (sales-eng): Yup. Drafting quote. Note on domain controls: we support DNS TXT claim and admin email verification for domains. For SCIM we require a service account with provisioning scope; sample mapping below:

```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "user.email",
  "name": {"givenName": "firstName", "familyName": "lastName"},
  "active": true,
  "groups": ["/Groups/{id}"]
}
```

alex (sales-eng): Also for RBAC: we map Okta groups -> Redwood roles using a mapping table, e.g., Okta group "eng-admins" -> role "admin". We'll include mapping template in quote.

sam (SE): POC checklist draft: SAML metadata uploaded, SCIM token tested (1-2 users), group sync validated, domain claimed, smoke tests on traffic, and a fallback plan (model variant) if latency spikes. I'll push checklist to workspace.

deploy-bot: deploy: created workspace finora-poc in us-west-2 (workspace id: finora-202403)

jordan (security): Couple of blockers to flag: 1) They require annual penetration test report — we have an NDA-safe redacted one. 2) They want KMS-backed keys for private deployment — that's an enterprise-only option; will need infra sign-off. I'll raise with infra.

maria (AE): Good catch. Finora also asked if we can surface employeeNumber and some custom SAML attributes to downstream tooling; can we pass through arbitrary attributes?

sam (SE): Yes — we can pass custom SAML attributes and map them into user profile fields. We'll need their attribute names in the metadata.

alex (sales-eng): Sending draft quote by 17:00 PT. Billing contact? Also confirm whether they want usage-based add-ons (cost+latency monitoring retention).

jordan (security): Uploading security pack and SOC2 evidence here: https://drive.example.com/redwood/sec-pack/finora (link restricted)

emily (solutions): For pricing note — if they sign annual dedicated we can include a 10% commit discount and 30-day rollback SLA for the POC period.

maria (AE): Ok I'll ask Finora for: SAML metadata, SCIM token + test user, DNS TXT for domain claim (or admin email option), billing contact, security questionnaire return. Kickoff scheduled 14:00 PT tomorrow — invite sent. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alex (sales-eng): I'll follow up after quote goes out.

sam (SE): I'll prepare the test accounts and sample group mappings tonight.

jordan (security): If infra needs to review KMS ask, cc me. I'll keep track.

maria (AE): Thread closed prep — will reopen if anything else pops up.
